_comment: Cold-outreach targets from the 'Somin's Placement' Google Sheet sweep (2026-09-09). Companies that fit Somin (2027 batch, SWE / Data-Science / ML, India) but have no live 2027-eligible posting we could queue, or a closed posting. The cold-mail feature (next iteration) will consume this. contact_type: 'email' = usable inbox; 'ats_portal' = no public email, apply/track via the linked portal; 'linkedin_ta' = best route is messaging a Talent Acquisition recruiter on LinkedIn; 'form' = application form only.
